priorStories.headline: Isaias reaches Category 2 near Gulf Coast
priorStories.body:
Hurricane Isaias had maximum sustained winds of 105 mph at 10 p.m. CDT, the National Hurricane Center said.

Hurricane and storm-surge warnings remained in effect along parts of the northern Gulf Coast, where evacuations and other preparations were underway.

priorStories.headline: Russian strike near Kramatorsk buses kills 33
priorStories.body:
A Russian guided bomb struck near two passenger buses in Kramatorsk, according to Ukrainian authorities. Later reporting from Ukraine’s emergency service put the death toll at 33, with 18 people injured.

Public transportation was suspended in Kramatorsk and nearby Sloviansk after the attack.

priorStories.headline: French protests close or disrupt 375 schools
priorStories.body:
France’s Education Ministry said 375 schools were fully or partially closed Thursday amid continuing protests over funding and conditions.

In northeastern Paris, police used tear gas after students erected barricades outside the Hélène Boucher high school. The Interior Ministry said more than 6,600 arrests had been made since the protests began in late September.

priorStories.headline: Santiago floods prompt over 1,000 evacuations
priorStories.body:
Heavy rain caused flash floods and mudslides in Santiago, sweeping away vehicles and flooding homes. Firefighters said they rescued or evacuated more than 1,000 people; authorities reported at least six injuries.

President José Antonio Kast declared an emergency in Las Condes after the Mapocho River overflowed.

priorStories.headline: Hurricane Simon prompts warnings in Mexico
priorStories.body:
Simon became a hurricane over the eastern Pacific with maximum sustained winds of 75 mph, the National Hurricane Center said.

At 9 p.m. CST, its center was about 235 miles south of Manzanillo. Hurricane warnings covered portions of Mexico’s southwestern and west-central coast.

candidates.summary: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to South African jurist and former U.N. human rights chief Navanethem “Navi” Pillay for her work promoting peace and international law. Pillay currently serves as an ad hoc judge at the International Court of Justice.
candidates.title: Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize

candidates.summary: Ukrainian officials reported that Friday morning Russian strikes killed one person and wounded five, including a child, in the Zaporizhzhia region, and killed another person in Ivano-Frankivsk. Ukraine’s Interior Ministry separately said strikes on warehouses in the Kyiv region’s Bucha district wounded three people and left a woman possibly trapped under rubble.
candidates.title: Russian strikes kill two across Ukraine

candidates.summary: The National Hurricane Center issued a tropical storm watch for the Southern California coast from the U.S.-Mexico border to the San Diego-Orange County line. Mexico issued watches for portions of both coasts of Baja California. Tropical Storm Rachel had maximum sustained winds of 50 mph at 8 a.m. PDT and was forecast to approach northern Baja California or Southern California late Saturday or early Sunday.
candidates.title: Tropical storm watches issued for Southern California and Baja California

candidates.summary: The National Hurricane Center extended a hurricane watch northward along Mexico’s Pacific coast from Punta Mita to San Blas. Hurricane Simon had maximum sustained winds of 100 mph at 9 a.m. CST and was about 210 miles south of Manzanillo, with forecasters warning that it could approach the coast as a major hurricane during the weekend.
candidates.title: Mexico extends Hurricane Simon watch northward

candidates.summary: Ukrainian officials reported that Russian strikes on Friday killed three people and wounded at least eight across Ukraine, an increase from the earlier reported toll of two dead and at least eight injured.
candidates.title: Russian strikes kill three across Ukraine

candidates.summary: A powerful earthquake struck central Panama at 17:56 UTC. The USGS listed the reviewed magnitude as 7.6, while later AP reporting described two powerful earthquakes and numerous aftershocks. Buildings partially collapsed near the epicenter, evacuations occurred across the country, and officials reported several injuries but no immediate deaths.
candidates.title: Powerful earthquakes strike central Panama

candidates.summary: President Donald Trump said he reached an agreement with Russian President Vladimir Putin for Russia to supply diesel to the United States and global markets. Trump said the initial shipment would exceed 300,000 tons. The Treasury Department subsequently issued a temporary license easing sanctions on Russian diesel loaded onto tankers beginning Friday.
candidates.title: Trump announces Russian diesel agreement

candidates.summary: Hurricane Isaias strengthened into a Category 3 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 120 mph Friday morning. Tropical-storm conditions began along the northern Gulf Coast during the afternoon. By 4 p.m. CDT, the National Hurricane Center estimated maximum sustained winds had decreased to about 110 mph as the storm approached landfall.
candidates.title: Isaias reaches Category 3 as conditions hit Gulf Coast

candidates.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser and commentator for Trump Media & Technology Group, would succeed Karoline Leavitt as White House press secretary. Leavitt left the position in August.
candidates.title: Trump names Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary

candidates.summary: Hurricane Isaias, which reached Category 3 strength Friday morning, made landfall near Destin, Florida, around 8:30 p.m. CDT with maximum sustained winds of 105 mph, the National Hurricane Center said. By 10 p.m. CDT, the center had moved inland and maximum sustained winds were estimated at 90 mph, though damaging winds, storm surge and flash flooding continued.
candidates.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall near Destin, Florida

candidates.summary: Hurricane Simon strengthened into a Category 3 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 120 mph by 9 p.m. CST. Its center was about 155 miles south of Manzanillo, and a hurricane warning remained in effect from Punta San Telmo to Punta Mita. Forecasters said preparations to protect life and property should be nearing completion.
candidates.title: Simon strengthens into major hurricane south of Mexico
